when_to_use: Use when creating or validating rivers, lakes, basins, wetlands, waterfalls, foam, mist, caustics, flow direction, velocity, or water export metadata.
do_not_use_for: Do not use for decorative flat planes, terrain-only valleys, or foliage placement except through derived wetness/water-edge masks.
required_callable_setup: Every water callable declares cell size, water units, downhill convention, edge contracts, and depth semantics.

Existing weakness to resolve: Still depends on configured canyon_paths/river_carves; no live visual proof in this run. Prior audit hint: Add paired cross-tile canyon/river carve visual and seam proof.
